facts.fact: INE published its Estatisticas Vitais 2024-2025 report, with births and deaths registered by the civil registration system in 2025 (8.8% and 38,032 deaths), reported on 2026-08-28.
INE's Estatisticas Vitais 2024-2025 draws its birth and death figures from the civil registration system's records.

MOZ.note: No civil register to ID link stated.

facts.fact: The electronic civil registration and vital statistics system e-SIRCEV was implemented in 2018, per INE's Estatisticas Vitais 2024-2025; the source does not say whether it covers the whole country.
INE's report says the civil registration system registered 8.8% of 2025 births (8.9% in 2024), not tied to the digital system.

MOZ.note: Does not say offices enter events digitally.
